note: Both sets capture the key textual facts (47,402.91 N•m saturation, 15,000 N•m/s rate limit, 1° blade-pitch trigger, gain-scheduled PI, 1173.7 rpm rated speed, no torsional-damping loop) and read the Figure 7-2 curves plausibly.
